haberler.baslik_kaynak: Kazakhstan and Guyana Join International Coalition Calling for Delay of EU Methane Regulation
haberler.ozet: Kazakhstan and Guyana have joined Algeria, Nigeria, Qatar, and the United States in calling on the European Union to delay implementation of, and make targeted changes to, the EU Methane Regulation (EUMR), removing unnecessary barriers to energy exports into Europe while ensuring a workable compliance framework.
